Imperfections and second order effects

The second order effects are not expected to be significant at the SLS. Hence.
these only need to be considered at the ULS. The requirement and method of
incorporating the second order effects in the analysis of structure are stipulated in
Section 5.3 of the code and will be explained later in due course.
